body.display_name: HAR Realized Semivariance with Day-of-Week Seasonality (HAR-RS-DOW)
body.model_architecture: Heterogeneous Autoregressive OLS with Semivariances and Day-of-Week Seasonality
body.output_units: Annualized Variance (decimal, e.g. 0.1930) and equivalent Annualized Volatility (%)
body.output_interpretation: Parametric point forecast of 7-day integrated volatility. Does NOT predict price direction (+/- return sign). Used exclusively for volatility regime assessment and risk envelopes.
body.uncertainty_engine: C2 Dependence-Aware Conformal Prediction (alpha=0.10, 90% nominal envelope, strictly causal delayed resolution)
body.empirical_validation_summary: 84.89% causal holdout containment (95% CI: [73.14%, 93.14%]) | 92.84% pre-2026 calibration (QLIKE: 0.19300). Validated in VOL-EDGE-01 & Stage 12 audit.
body.applicable_limitations: Not a directional alpha model; does not recommend buy/sell positions; requires hourly OHLCV. Serves 168h realized variance volatility intelligence only. Live trading is strictly disabled.
